verdict.rationale: Orama's pricing page says the open-source search library can be added to your own application at no cost. That implies no per-request charges when you self-host the library. However, nothing in the evidence documents Orama Cloud's pricing model, how cost scales with record count or query volume, or whether metered thresholds or overage cliffs exist. Missing for 10: documented Cloud pricing tiers, explicit record and query limits or overage terms, a statement of flat or non-per-request pricing at scale, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, costs stay predictable as records and query volume grow — no surprise per-request cliffs

citations.quote: The open-source search library. Add fast, relevant search to your own application at no cost.
